[LNUL.6.2] **Ordering** is pinned: for the internal deterministic total order
(fact ordering / dedup / hash) `null` sorts **below all values** ([LNUL.8.1]), so
any total order over `T?` is deterministic. (Author-facing order operators
`<`/`>`/`min`/`max` over a `T?` still *propagate* `null` per [LNUL.4.1]; the
below-all substrate order and the 3-valued comparisons coexist.)
